changelog: Settings → Capture Sources can opt into an isolated VoxyWatch Probe for dedicated SPAN/RSPAN interfaces, ERSPAN II/III, or AWS VPC Traffic Mirroring VXLAN.
The probe normalizes only the inner SIP/RTP/RTCP tuple into the existing loopback HEP pipeline; native HEP and SIPREC remain independent and unchanged.
Safe defaults require an explicit dedicated interface, learn media from SDP, deduplicate mirrored directions, and keep heuristic media behind trusted SBC/voice
